author: Cip
body:
This should really go on the GitHub but I don't have an account on there and I can't find a link to it.

Absolutely NO kills are being recorded and added to people's stats and I would presume therefore objectives aren't either, probably has something to do with the tracker being disabled and I'm fully aware it's just a side effect of the atlas update and it's just another kink to iron out.

I don't know how long this would take but would it be possible for objectives to be added to players Stats Page? I definitely would enjoy that as a new feature and I'm sure other players would too.
